notes.title: Future of Enspell -1
notes.content:
[b]Hello, Enspell players![/b]
First of all, we sincerely thank you all for enjoying Enspell and providing valuable feedback since its early access. We would like to introduce you to the content we have been providing from Enspell's early access to its official release.

[h2]Stages[/h2]
[h3]Curse Difficulty[/h3]
We are planning to provide a greater challenge to players who have cleared up to stage 3. The 'Curse Difficulty' will not only increase the difficulty but also offer a new feel to the gameplay experience. The player's choices and time spent will make the curse more powerful.

[h2]Changes in Curse Difficulty[/h2]
[h3]Monsters[/h3]
In the Curse Difficulty, monsters will become stronger with increased health and shield. Additionally, the cards used by monsters will be enhanced or changed with new effects. As a result, players will need to adjust their existing strategies and explore new deck-building methods.

[h3]Map[/h3]
In the Curse Difficulty, the information provided on the current map will be limited. Only information about the paths taken and adjacent rooms will be displayed, requiring players to be more cautious in managing health and battling monsters!

The Curse Difficulty will present various situations that are more challenging or unreasonable. We encourage you to accumulate enough combat experience to prepare for these tougher situations.

[h2]New Characters[/h2]
A new character, the [b]Rogue[/b], is set to be introduced. The Rogue will engage in combat with agility and unique style, unlike the Warrior. New Rogue character images, Rogue-exclusive cards, and artifacts will be added, each contributing to the Rogue's uniqueness.

[h2]New Events[/h2]
We plan to introduce a new NPC, the Witch. The Witch will appear randomly on stages and provide beneficial effects such as card transformation, duplication, and removal. Through the Witch, players will be able to build desired decks or create destructive ones.

Your interest and feedback on Enspell greatly contribute to providing a better gameplay experience. We will do our best to provide new content as quickly as possible. We hope you look forward to future updates. We'll see you soon with the next update!
